# Kinship

> > Kinship is a comprehensive pet parenting resource offering expert guidance on dog and cat behavior, health, nutrition, training, and lifestyle.

Kinship provides accessible, veterinary-backed information for pet parents covering everything from puppy and kitten onboarding through advanced wellness topics. The site includes free starter packs (littleKin), detailed health guides, and practical training and nutrition resources for both dogs and cats.

## Key Topics

- Dog Health & Behavior
- Cat Health & Behavior
- Pet Wellness
- Pet Nutrition
- Pet Training
- Pet Parenting
- Routine Care
- Skin Issues & Allergies
- Pet Safety
- Emergencies & First Aid
- Dental Health
- Pet Grooming
- Holistic Vet Care
- littleKin Starter Packs

## Pet Parenting Hubs

- [Kinship Homepage](https://www.kinship.com): Kinship homepage offering expert guidance on cat, dog, and pet care.
- [Pet Parenting Hub](https://www.kinship.com/pet): Kinship pet parenting hub covering dog and cat behavior, training, lifestyle.
- [Dog Guide](https://www.kinship.com/dog): Dog-focused guide covering behavior, training, health, nutrition, lifestyle.
- [Cat Guide](https://www.kinship.com/cat): Cat-focused guide covering behavior, health, care, lifestyle, nutrition.

## Pet Health & Wellness

- [Pet Health Hub](https://www.kinship.com/pet-health): Pet health hub with veterinary advice on wellness, conditions, treatments.
- [Routine Care](https://www.kinship.com/pet-health/routine-care): Guide to everyday pet wellness: vet checks, preventative care, vaccines.
- [Conditions & Treatments](https://www.kinship.com/pet-health/conditions-treatments): Expert guide on common and uncommon pet health issues and treatments.
- [Skin Issues & Allergies](https://www.kinship.com/pet-health/skin-issues-allergies): Guide to pet skin conditions, allergies, fleas, ear mites, grooming.
- [Emergencies & First Aid](https://www.kinship.com/pet-health/emergencies-first-aid): Pet emergency guide: when to seek care, first aid, product recalls.
- [Pet Safety](https://www.kinship.com/pet-health/safety): Pet safety guide: pet-proofing, toxic substances, seasonal hazard prevention.
- [Dental Health](https://www.kinship.com/pet-health/dental-health): Pet dental care guide: teeth brushing, cleaning, products, prevention.

## Pet Nutrition & Feeding

- [Pet Nutrition Hub](https://www.kinship.com/pet-nutrition): Pet nutrition hub: food, treats, supplements, recipes, weight management.
- [Food & Food Toppers](https://www.kinship.com/pet-nutrition/food-and-food-toppers): Pet food guide: kibble, canned, fresh, dehydrated, human-grade options.
- [Treats](https://www.kinship.com/pet-nutrition/treats): Pet treats guide: training bites, catnip chews, healthy human food snacks.
- [Vitamins & Supplements](https://www.kinship.com/pet-nutrition/vitamins-supplements): Pet vitamins and supplements guide: Omega-3s, probiotics, joint health.

## New Pet Starter Packs

- [littleKin Starter Packs](https://www.kinship.com/littlekin): littleKin free starter packs for new puppy and kitten parents with samples.
- [littleKin Kitten Kit](https://www.kinship.com/littlekin/kitten): Free littleKin kitten starter kit with resources and exclusive offers.
- [littleKin Puppy Pack](https://www.kinship.com/littlekin/puppy): Free littleKin puppy pack with wellness visit, samples, training resources.

## Optional Resources

- [Pet Grooming](https://www.kinship.com/pet-health/grooming): Pet grooming tutorials: nail clipping, bathing, grooming product tips.
- [Holistic Vet Care](https://www.kinship.com/pet-health/holistic-vet-care): Alternative pet care guide: massage, herbal remedies, supplements, CBD.
